source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately reporting failed municipal water-quality tests to protect the public

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
List the inspection slips by sample location and date of testing. (For faster retrieval, alphabetize location names to create a location index in the front of the binder.)
3. Is the reading well above the regulatory limit? If so, skip to #7. If not, is it far higher than the mean reading from a series of previous tests? If not, go to #4. If so, go to #5.
4. Are these samples from just one location, or multiple locations? If just one, skip to #7. If multiple, go to #5.
5. Do all the out-of-compliance samples, across all sample locations, follow a consistent trend? If yes, go to #6. If not, proceed to #7.
6. [If all samples showed a similar trend] What set of conditions might explain this change? Did a change in treatment protocol, sampling date, or analysis lab
